boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented RMU study environments, from library work areas to residence-hall lounges with study tables.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library
cards.subtitle: Patrick Henry Center, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Start here when you need a choice of quiet and group settings; bring your laptop and use the library’s wireless network.
cards.short_summary: RMU’s main library combines quiet and collaborative study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU identifies its library in Patrick Henry as including quiet and group spaces, some with computers and whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Located in the Patrick Henry Center on campus; confirm current building access and library hours before arrival.

cards.title: Library 24-7 Zone
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Use this computer-equipped library zone for a late independent work session; check campus status before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A library zone with Windows computers and availability outside standard library hours.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says the Library’s 24-7 Zone has Windows computers and that 24-7 quiet study space is available whenever campus is not closed.
cards.access_notes: RMU states 24-7 quiet study is available anytime campus is not closed; standard library service hours vary.

cards.title: Library Research Room
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Choose the Research Room when you need library PCs for a focused task; save work to your account or a flash drive.
cards.short_summary: A named library room with small tables and PCs for research work.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU’s library services page says two small tables with PCs are located within the Library’s Research Room.
cards.access_notes: Inside the library; access is subject to current library and campus building hours.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Ask at the library help desk about a study-room key, then plan your session around the documented three-hour loan period.
cards.short_summary: Library study rooms with keys loaned for three hours.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists Study Room Keys with a three-hour borrowing period for students.
cards.source_title: Library General Resources | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Study-room keys are borrowed through the library; RMU lists a three-hour loan period.

cards.title: Elaine Boyd Library Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Elaine Boyd Library, Patrick Henry Center
cards.notes: Set up at a table with an outlet when your laptop needs a long charge; library wireless supports personal devices.
cards.short_summary: Outlet-equipped tables designed for laptop-based study.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU reports that the library has many study tables equipped with outlets for recharging laptops.
cards.access_notes: Inside the library; verify current library hours and access before planning a session.

cards.title: Jefferson Center 24/7 Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Jefferson Center, 346 Massey Way
cards.notes: Use this named computer lab when you need a campus workstation; bring your RMU credentials and confirm current building access.
cards.short_summary: A 24/7 computer lab in RMU’s Jefferson Center.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU lists the Jefferson Center’s primary uses as including a 24/7 Computer Lab.
cards.access_notes: RMU lists the lab as 24/7; building-entry requirements and any temporary restrictions should be confirmed locally.

cards.entity_name: Center for Veterans and Military Families
cards.title: Center for Veterans and Military Families
cards.subtitle: Lower level of Jefferson Center
cards.notes: Military-affiliated students can use the center’s quiet study area or computer lab; contact CVMF first to confirm eligibility.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated support center with quiet study space and a computer lab.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU describes its Center for Veterans and Military Families as having a computer lab, quiet study area, lounge space, and conference room.
cards.source_title: RMU Center for Veterans and Military Families | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: The center serves military-connected students and families; contact CVMF for eligibility and current access details.

cards.title: Hamilton Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Hamilton Hall, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Hamilton residents can use its lounge’s study tables for a close-to-home work block; respect resident-only access and shared use.
cards.short_summary: A renovated residence-hall lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Hamilton Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: A residence-hall lounge; access is for the residential community and subject to Residence Life policies.

cards.title: Marshall Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Marshall Hall, Moon Campus
cards.notes: Marshall residents can settle into the lounge’s study tables between classes; leave the space ready for the next community use.
cards.short_summary: A renovated Marshall Hall lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Marshall Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: A residence-hall lounge; access is for the residential community and subject to Residence Life policies.

cards.title: Yorktown Hall Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Yorktown Hall, 8256 University Boulevard
cards.notes: Yorktown residents can use lounge study tables for a nearby session; account for the hall’s off-campus location when planning travel.
cards.short_summary: A Yorktown residence lounge with study tables and a community kitchen.
cards.evidence_claim: RMU says residence lounges have study tables and identifies Yorktown Hall’s lounge as equipped with a modern community kitchen.
cards.source_title: Residence Hall Amenities | Robert Morris University
cards.access_notes: Yorktown is a residence-hall space about a mile up University Boulevard from campus; resident access applies.
